label: sec:entropic-gravity-data
html:
Existing data sets

  • Cavendish-type torsion balance experiments (e.g., Eöt-Wash group).
  • Casimir force measurements at micrometre scales. See conj:casimir-epsilon-vacuum for the QOU prediction. The textbook F_{\text{Cas}}/A \approx -\pi^{2}\hbar c/(240\, d^{4}) forms the standard-part of an \omega \cdot \varepsilon surreal product under the \varepsilon-relaxed vacuum axiom.
  • Neutron interferometry (gravity resonance spectroscopy).

Planned observations

  • MICROSCOPE follow-up missions: Improved equivalence principle tests in space.
  • Atom interferometry experiments (MAGIS, AION, ZAIGA) probing gravitational decoherence.

Potential new experiments

  • Entanglement-assisted gravity experiments testing whether gravitational interactions preserve quantum coherence as predicted by the q-deformed field equations.
  • High-precision measurements of Casimir forces in geometries designed to isolate contributions from q-deformed vacuum fluctuations. See conj:casimir-first-q-correction. The leading 1/d^{4} force is substrate-independent. The first q-dependent correction is carried by the figure-eight knot 4_1 at the interacting (subleading) order. Its relative size \sim \alpha\,\lambda_C/d sits below present experimental reach, making this a structural prediction rather than a near-term discriminator.
